# StayScape - Rental Marketplace

StayScape is a modern accommodation and rental marketplace platform built with Next.js 14, React, Tailwind CSS, and Prisma (SQLite/PostgreSQL).

## Features
- Guest, Host, and Admin roles
- Property listings, booking engine, and payments (Stripe)
- Messaging system, Wishlists, Reviews, and Support Tickets
- Robust RBAC security and moderation tools

## Legal & Compliance
- Data is heavily minimized.
- Legal documents (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, etc.) are available on the site.
- Built-in cookie consent banner.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js App Router, React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Lucide React
- Backend: Next.js API Routes, Prisma ORM, NextAuth (Auth.js) v5
- Database: SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod)
